policy: Entries must use a vendor-authoritative HTTPS source and a vendor-published SHA-256 value. Do not stage a product until its version, source URL, checksum, support channel, and approval status are verified.

packages.installationVerification: Record actual Program Files executable and matching HKLM uninstall registration versions; the web installer payload and browser can update independently of the Gallery version.
packages.stagingBlocker: Chrome ZIP is the current demo recipe; chromezip 157.8103.2's tested actions are preserved in config/chromezip-tested-commands.json. Approve your own Gallery version, authorized source, EXE hash/signer, ZIP hash, reviewed commands, recovery and pilot scope before staging. The tested web-installer commands do not pin the installed browser version or verify hashes, signatures, exit codes, and complete guest registration postconditions. Do not substitute the historical MSI recipe or infer broader approval from the lab test.
